exceptions.rationale: glib 0.18.5 is transitively resolved through Tauri/Wry's Linux GTK3 stack. The supported migration to glib 0.20 or newer requires the upstream GTK4/WebKitGTK 6 migration. Livariant does not directly use VariantStrIter, Windows does not use this GTK runtime path, and the Dependabot alert must remain open until the upstream-compatible fix is available.
